_doc: P1 (C′ reframe, 2026-09-08) column policy for outputs/{site}/cfd_analysis/per_patch_indicators.csv. P1's ventilation axis is DESCRIPTIVE GEOMETRY ONLY — no simulation-derived quantity may reach a P1 figure, table, or claim. Enforced by scripts/lint_p1_columns.py, wired into .claude/verify-cmd.

p1_banned_cfd_output._why: Direct products of a numerical simulation. P1 makes no simulation-based claim.

p1_banned_cfd_setup._why: Not simulation results, but their DEFINITIONS presuppose one (a blockage ratio or an 'eligible for a run' flag is a non-question in a paper with no numerical simulation). Banned for the same reason simulation vocabulary is banned from P1.

p1_output_convention.rule: WP-06 writes P1's own geometry table containing ONLY p1_legal columns, produced by code that never imports the simulation post-processing module. The lint is the backstop, not the primary defence.

_changelog.change: Added 11 columns to p1_legal for outputs/{site}/geometry_indicators/per_patch_geometry.csv: svf_c_p50, kwh_m2_p50, sun_h_winter_p50, share_ge_2h_winter (medians/share of the WP-04 1 m ground SVF/sun-hours inside the cell; engine = raster horizon, sky = epw_weighted), wind_exposure, exposure_ratio (scripts.run_wind_exposure), open_edge_dist_m (scripts.run_lateral_connectivity), constraint_vertical, constraint_lateral, constraint_directional, n_constraints (scripts.run_ventilation_index.count_constraints, the council-locked ordinal 0-3 checklist). All geometry x climatology x WP-04 solar, none simulation-derived. Does not touch the pinned 52-column source schema (outputs/{site}/cfd_analysis/per_patch_indicators.csv), so the schema-drift check is unaffected.
